name: epiton
description: Epiton — modern multiplatform Tryton-compatible client platform

scripts.test:e2e:mock: playwright test e2e/login.spec.ts e2e/workspace.spec.ts e2e/board.spec.ts e2e/wizard-report.spec.ts e2e/calendar.spec.ts
scripts.lab:up:8: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile tryton8 up -d --build db8 tryton8 gateway8
scripts.lab:oracle:7: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile oracle7 run --rm --build --no-deps proteus7
scripts.lab:oracle:8: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml --profile tryton8 --profile oracle8 run --rm --build --no-deps proteus8
scripts.compat:live: pnpm --filter @epiton/protocol build && pnpm --filter @epiton/view-engine build && node scripts/compat-live.mjs
